annotation.summary: A car chooses the exit ramp instead of continuing along the straight road.
annotation.visual: A highway splits into a straight route and a right-hand exit. Road signs have blank label areas, and a car swerves toward the exit ramp.
annotation.mechanism: The two routes represent alternative choices, and the car visibly commits to the exit. A sudden, tempting, or ill-advised change of plan can add a second layer of humor.
scenarios: Plan to go to bed but choose to watch another video
Intend to save money but take the shopping option
Choose route B at a fork between routes A and B

examples.why: The car takes the tempting alternative to the original plan.
